OnlyCashbacks

OnlyCashbacks is a fully open-source, privacy-first personal rewards co-pilot and card optimizer. Sample screens use only your tokens; the words are examples.

Typography

round(14 x 1.25^n): 12, 14, 18, 22, 27, 34px. Weights body 400, label 500, heading 650.

headline.md 34/44 650Page and section titles.
headline.sm 27/32 650Page and section titles.
title.lg 22/32 650Card, panel and group titles.
numeric.lg 22/32 650Key numbers: balances, KPIs.
body.lg 18/24 400Long-form reading, onboarding copy.
title.md 18/24 650Card, panel and group titles.
body.md 14/20 400Default UI text: forms, tables, descriptions.
label.lg 14/20 500Button and control labels.
code.md 14/20 400Code blocks, token names.
title.sm 14/20 650Table headers, field-group titles.
numeric.md 14/20 400Amounts and table figures: tabular digits line up in columns; right-align numeric columns.
body.sm 12/16 400Helper text, timestamps, captions.
label.sm 12/16 500Overlines in capitals with wide tracking (DC-L02-18).
label.md 12/16 500Small control labels, badges, dense tabs.
code.sm 12/16 400Inline values, dense code rows.
